Author: Stwohm (fork of yagi2/Restocker)
Name: Restocky
Changelog: 0.3.13.0 — Sold-out items are restocked at the live market price (game Compare prices), not the last sale; market prices survive plugin reloads. New Runs tab: last 20 runs with what changed, what was skipped and why, copyable. Why tooltip on every Reprice row (decision, guards, floor, bait, scan age). Stock tracking: stock per source (bag, saddlebags, retainers) with freshness (? unread, ! partial), restock mode Default/Auto/Alert (Trial = Alert) with a Next cycle preview, Only low filter, gil/unit labels. Stack top-up respects Per listing; Restock is disabled when there is nothing to do. A sale frees its retainer slot immediately; a full preferred retainer is named in the plan. Fixes: no-result market searches, top-up readback, cross-character sale matching, CSV earning column, restock skips and failures reported.
Punchline: Restocker fork: bulk reprice with price guards, sales tracking and an optional bell auto-cycle.
Description: Personal fork of yagi2/Restocker. Reprice every retainer listing to the live market lowest -N gil with floor / max-drop guards, track each listing until it sells (reprices, competitors, days, gil), one-click full cycle and an optional timed auto-cycle at the summoning bell that waits for AutoRetainer. Timed automation is against the FFXIV ToS; use at your own risk.
